description: We are adding two floors to an existing one-storey warehouse. The altered building and foundation work are being designed under Part 4. The proposal is to reuse every existing footing without checking any of the applicable foundation requirements for the new building, because the old building has shown no visible settlement.
known_facts: warehouse increased from one storey to three
no check against applicable foundation requirements for altered building
absence of visible settlement offered as rationale

gold.departure: Existing foundations are reused without establishing conformity with the applicable foundation requirements for the altered building.
gold.engineering_reason: The described design is explicitly carried out under Part 4, requiring a registered professional skilled in the work.
